newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end off highs, buoyed by Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end off highs, buoyed by Wall St.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended off the highs, supported by a stronger Wall Street, dealers said. The Lisbon market eased back in midsession after France said it was not ready to accept a stability pact limiting budget deficits after the launch of the euro in 1999. Banking stocks, cement group Cimpor, Portugal Telecom, pulp group Portucel Industrial and retailer Sonae Investimentos will attract strong demand as investors expect the partial privatisation of EDP-Electricidade de Portugal to be heavily oversubscribed, dealers said. Both June and July futures ended higher.
